'$'''tee >(while read -r n, do
 echo "Branch1: $n" 1>&2 &
done) >(while read -r n, do
 echo "Branch2: $n" 1>&2 &
done) (&)' (1,661 us, 0.07%)

'$'''result=$({ echo "Level 1" & echo "$({ echo "Level 2" & echo "$({ echo "Level 3" & echo "$(echo "Level 4" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 4 done")" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 3 done", } & wait 2> /dev/null)" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 2 done"' (382 us, 0.02%)
'for sig in HUP INT QUIT TERM USR1 USR2' (458 us, 0.02%)
'dynamic_array["$(echo "$key" | md5sum | cut -d'\'' '\'' -f1)"]="$(echo "Value for $key" | base64 & wait $!)" (&)' (1,672 us, 0.07%)

'$'\''diff <(while IFS= read -r line, do\n echo "$line" | tee >(sed \'\''s/.*/PROC1: &/\'\'' 1>&2) | { cat | while read -r x, do\n echo "$x" | tee >(wc -l 1>&2) | { awk \'\''{print "AWK:", $0}\'\'' | tee >(grep -v \'\''^$\'\'' 1>&2) & wait $! 2> /dev/null || true, },\' (369 us, 0.01%)

'$'''eval "nested_func_$depth() {
 local my_depth=$depth
 { { { echo \"Depth: \$my_depth\" >&2, } 2>&1 | sed '''s/^/ /''' >&2, } & } &
 wait \$! 2>/dev/null || true
 generate_recursive_hell \$((depth + 1))
' (121 us, 0.00%)
'echo "Bash Profiler Destroyer completed. Check if your profiler survived!" 1>&2' (210 us, 0.01%)

'$'''echo "$({ echo "Level 2" & echo "$({ echo "Level 3" & echo "$(echo "Level 4" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 4 done")" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 3 done", } & wait 2> /dev/null)" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 2 done", } & wait 2> /dev/null)" (&' (562 us, 0.02%)

'$'\''echo "$({ echo "Level 3" & echo "$(echo "Level 4" & wait 2> /dev/null\necho "Level 4 done")" & wait 2> /dev/null\necho "Level 3 done", } & wait 2> /dev/null)" (&)' (1,528 us, 0.06%)
